$comment: The pools that generated text conversations are built from (README.md, conversations.json). A generated thread is one topic: an opener from the person, a staff reply, then follow-ups back and forth, and sometimes a closing. Every entry stands alone, so any entry works with any other entry of the same topic. 'numbers' says where a topic happens (personal, main, or students), and 'audience' who texts (adult, parent, or student). Tokens: {name}, {staff}, and {campus}. The Cast's own threads are in cast/sms-threads.json.
